findings.description: What is worth changing, one finding each. Empty when nothing is: a finding invented to look thorough costs a round.

file.description: The file, by path from the workspace root.

line.description: The line it is about; null when it is about something absent, such as a test nobody wrote.

what.description: What goes wrong, concretely: the input or the case, and the wrong result.

again.description: true when a finding is worth another round: the engineer is handed your findings and the change comes back to you. false when it is done as far as a review can tell.
